annotations.title: Find BetterKids activities for an age

description: Find BetterKids activities that fit a child's age, a skill and the minutes you have. Searches the app's real content catalog (232 activities across 14 areas: Hero Training, Leo's Piano, Nature Explorer, World Explorer, Little Swimmer, Little Dojo, Jobs, Car Explorer, math, mazes, coding and English words). Send age_years OR age_months (the app covers ages 3-9), optionally skill, area, minutes (the most minutes one go may take) and needs_grown_up. Each result has an id, English and Vietnamese titles, age bands, skill tags, typical minutes (with whether it is computed, stated by the app or an estimate), a one-line how-to and whether the app's notes ask a grown-up to be nearby. Read-only, no account, no network calls. Never include a child's name or any personal detail.

age_months.description: Child's age in months (12-216). Provide age_months OR age_years, not both. The app's content covers 36-119 months (ages 3-9).

age_years.description: Child's age in whole years (1-18). Provide age_years OR age_months, not both. The app's content covers ages 3-9.

area.description: Filter by app area, for example piano, nature, hero-training, maze.

minutes.description: Only activities that take at most this many minutes per go.

needs_grown_up.description: true = only activities where the app's notes ask a grown-up to be nearby; false = only those that do not.

offset.description: Skip this many results, for paging.

skill.description: Filter by skill tag (see list_topics for the list).

name: list_activities

age_bands.description: Age bands (3-4, 5-6, 7-9) the activity is made for.

id.description: Stable activity id, usable with get_activity and how_to_teach.

minutes_basis.description: computed = from reps x tempo; app-stated = a number the app states; estimate = a planning estimate, not a measurement.

needs_grown_up.description: True when the app's own notes ask a grown-up to be nearby or to join in.

source.description: Repo path the activity was read from.

band.description: The age band used for filtering, or null when no age was sent.

title: Find BetterKids activities for an age
